title: Web Research Agent
description: A LangGraph agent that searches the web for any topic and synthesizes a structured research report.

title: Code Review Agent
description: An AI agent that reviews code for bugs, security issues, performance problems, and style violations.

title: PDF Q&A Agent
description: Loads any PDF and lets you ask questions about it. Supports both single-question and interactive chat modes.

title: SQL Query Agent
description: Connects to any SQLite database and answers natural language questions by generating and executing SQL.

title: Email Drafting Agent
description: A CrewAI two-agent system that drafts professional emails. An analyst agent extracts requirements, then a writer agent produces the final email.

title: News Summarizer Agent
description: Fetches news articles on any topic and produces a structured briefing with key themes and insights.

title: GitHub Issue Triager
description: Automatically triages GitHub issues: assigns severity, category, labels, and routing recommendations.

title: Data Analysis Agent
description: Chat with your data. Load any CSV or Excel file and ask analytical questions in natural language.

title: Resume Parser Agent
description: Parses resumes (TXT or PDF) into structured JSON and optionally scores candidate fit against a job description.

title: Meeting Notes Agent
description: Converts meeting transcripts into structured notes with summary, action items, decisions, and follow-ups.

title: Stock Research Agent
description: Fetches real-time stock data via Yahoo Finance and generates an AI-powered investment analysis.

title: Travel Planner Agent
description: Three-agent CrewAI system that creates personalized travel itineraries with destination research, day-by-day plans, and budget breakdown.

title: Customer Support Agent
description: LangGraph-powered support agent with RAG knowledge base and automatic escalation routing.

title: Social Media Content Agent
description: Generates platform-optimized social media content (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram) from any topic.

title: Unit Test Generator Agent
description: Analyzes Python code and generates comprehensive pytest test suites — happy paths, edge cases, and error conditions.

title: Documentation Writer Agent
description: Generates comprehensive documentation for Python modules: README, API reference, and Google-style docstrings.

title: Recipe Recommendation Agent
description: Suggests 3 recipes from your available ingredients with full instructions, nutritional info, and chef tips.

title: Job Application Agent
description: CrewAI agent that generates a complete job application package: cover letter, tailored resume bullets, interview questions, and salary range.

title: Competitive Analysis Agent
description: LangGraph multi-step agent that identifies competitors, analyzes each one, and generates a strategic competitive report.

title: Multi-Agent Debate System
description: Two AI agents debate any topic from opposing sides, with an impartial AI judge declaring a winner.

title: PII Sanitization Agent
description: Removes sensitive data from text **before** it reaches an LLM or external API.
